name: 62690 · Virden, IL
findings: ZIP 62690 (Virden) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62690 (Virden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
